title: Chicken Enchiladas (Enchiladas de Pollo)
description: Chicken Enchiladas (Enchiladas de Pollo) are tender corn tortillas filled with shredded chicken, rolled in a rich homemade red chile sauce, topped with melted cheese, and baked until bubbly. A classic Mexican comfort dish perfect for a restaurant-quality meal at home.

ingredients.title: For the Chicken
items: Chicken breasts or thighs, boneless – 2 lbs (900 g)
Chicken broth or water – 2 cups (480 ml)

ingredients.title: For the Enchilada Sauce (Red Chile Sauce)
items: Dried guajillo chiles, stems and seeds removed – 4
Dried ancho chiles, stems and seeds removed – 2

ingredients.title: For the Enchiladas
items: Corn tortillas (softened in oil or steamed) – 12
Shredded cheese (Mexican blend, Oaxaca, or Chihuahua cheese) – 1½ cups (170 g)
Sour cream or Mexican crema – ½ cup (120 ml)
Optional: diced onions, sliced avocado, pickled jalapeños

instruction.title: Step 1 – Cook the Chicken
steps: In a medium pot, combine chicken, onion, garlic, salt, pepper, and chicken broth.
Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer for 20–25 minutes, until chicken is fully cooked.
Remove chicken, shred finely with two forks, and set aside. Reserve 1 cup of broth for sauce if needed.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Prepare the Red Enchilada Sauce
steps: Toast dried chiles lightly in a dry skillet over medium heat for 1–2 minutes (don't burn).
Soak the chiles in hot water for 15–20 minutes until soft. Drain.
In a blender, combine softened chiles, garlic, onion, cumin, oregano, and 1 cup chicken broth. Blend until smooth.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Pour in blended sauce, simmer for 10–12 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper. If sauce is too thick, add reserved chicken broth.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Assemble the Enchiladas
steps: Dip each tortilla into the warm sauce to coat, then fill with shredded chicken and a sprinkle of cheese. Roll tightly and place seam-side down in the baking dish.
Pour remaining sauce over the top of the rolled enchiladas. Sprinkle remaining cheese evenly.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Bake and Serve
steps: Bake in preheated oven for 15–20 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly.
Garnish with chopped cilantro, a drizzle of crema, and optional avocado slices or pickled jalapeños.
Serve immediately with Mexican rice or refried beans for a full restaurant-quality experience.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve with Mexican rice or refried beans for a complete meal.
Pair with guacamole, fresh salsa, and tortilla chips.
Garnish with extra cilantro, crema, and lime wedges before serving.

chefTips: Tortillas: Use fresh corn tortillas and lightly fry or steam before rolling to prevent cracking.
Sauce Depth: Toasting chiles and simmering the sauce develops complex flavors.
Cheese: Oaxaca cheese melts beautifully and adds an authentic Mexican touch.
Presentation: Drizzle crema in a zig-zag, sprinkle finely chopped cilantro, and place avocado slices symmetrically for a professional finish.
